title: Saint Louis University Students Participate in Camino de SLU
summary_en: Ahead of the beatification Mass for Archbishop Fulton J. Sheen in St. Louis on Thursday, Sept. 24, a group of Saint Louis University students and Jesuit scholastics participated in a Camino, or walking tour of significant places, from campus to the Old Cathedral on St. Louis' riverfront, stopping at historic churches along the way.
